checks.detail: Failed D9 checks: fpr_every_day_seed, alert_rate, bot_recall, calibration, external_dataset, prospective_pilot, site_cost_model
checks.remediation: Resolve the failed D9 checks in docs/COST_MODEL_AND_RELEASE_GATE.md. Do not raise the detection score until they pass.
checks.requirement: The D9 cost-sensitive detection gate must pass on every check.

checks.detail: Serving hash, registry entry, and evaluated artifact agree.
checks.remediation: Serve, evaluate, and gate the same artifact before any release claim.
checks.requirement: The served artifact must be the artifact that was evaluated and gated, and the deployment hash check must pass.

checks.detail: The security gate passes. Unfixed base-image advisories remain accepted risk.
checks.remediation: Fix every actionable finding and rebuild the image.
checks.requirement: No critical, fixable, secret, or failed-misconfiguration findings.

checks.detail: No secrets detected in git-visible files.
checks.remediation: Remove and rotate every detected credential, then rescan.
checks.requirement: The git-visible working tree must contain no detected secrets.

checks.detail: The external review is not complete or has open critical/high findings.
checks.remediation: Track every finding to closure and publish the signed review report.
checks.requirement: An external security and readiness review must be completed and critical/high findings closed.

checks.detail: No real pilot result exists. Synthetic self-tests are not evidence.
checks.remediation: Recruit a consenting design partner and run the pre-registered pilot.
checks.requirement: A real human-review pilot must be completed against predeclared criteria.

checks.detail: The measured ingest SLO is met.
checks.remediation: Fix persistence latency and backpressure before claiming production readiness.
checks.requirement: Measured ingest p95 must be <= 250 ms at 20 flows/s with >= 99.5% success.

checks.detail: The local and encrypted backup/restore drills pass. Operated off-host durability and site RPO/RTO remain unproven.
checks.remediation: Fix the restore path. Production also needs operated off-host storage and measured RPO/RTO.
checks.requirement: Local and encrypted backup/restore drills must pass with integrity and count checks.

checks.remediation: Regenerate the SBOM from the built image.
checks.requirement: A CycloneDX SBOM must exist and contain components.

consequence: No 9/10 detection or SaaS readiness claim is allowed. Keep detection at 4/10 and production SaaS at 3/10 until every check passes.
